items.title: 9.9.2 Titration curve aur equivalence point (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9.2, printed pages 206-208, with Table 9.7 and Quick Check 9.6 as self-checks.

blocks.text: pH curve (titration curve) woh graph hai jo dalay gaye titrant ke hajm (volume) ke muqable solution ka pH dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “verses” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “versus” (muqable mein) hai.

blocks.title: Equivalence point
blocks.text: Equivalence point woh nuqta hai jahan dala gaya titrant analyte solution ko bilkul poora neutralize karne ke liye kaafi ho.

Titration curves dikhate hain ke acidic ya basic solution mein basic ya acidic solution dalne se pH kaise badalta hai. Titration curve se hum aisa indicator chunte hain jo bata de ke titration mukammal ho gaya aur equivalence point aa gaya. Titration ka end point woh hai jahan indicator rang badalta hai. Hum aisa indicator chunte hain jis ka end point equivalence point ke qareeb ho.
Misal ke taur par HCl ki NaOH se titration lein. Shuru mein solution mein sirf strong acid hai. Strong acid poora dissociate hota hai, is liye H⁺ ki concentration zyada aur pH bohat kam hota hai.
NaOH dalne par us ke OH⁻ ions HCl ke H⁺ ions ko neutralize karna shuru karte hain aur pH barhta hai.

Equivalence point tab aata hai jab dale gaye OH⁻ ki miqdar acid mein asal H⁺ ki miqdar ke barabar (stoichiometric taur par) ho jaye. Strong acid-strong base titration mein equivalence point par pH 7.0 hota hai. Is jagah curve mein pH tezi se oopar uchhalta hai, acidic se neutral. End point ke aas paas pH taqreeban 4.0 se 10.0 tak badalta hai. Equivalence par pH 7.0 hai, is liye phenolphthalein jaisa indicator istemal ho sakta hai kyunke woh is range mein rang badalta hai.

blocks.alt: Titration curve: pH (0 se 14) ke muqable shamil kiye gaye strong base ka hajm (0 se 80 mL), nuqton ke saath. pH taqreeban 1 se shuru ho kar aahista barhta hai, 40 mL par taqreeban seedha oopar chhalang lagata hai aur 12.5 ke qareeb thehar jata hai. Dashed lakeer 'pH = 7.00 at equivalence point'. Tez hisse par rangeen pattiyan phenolphthalein (taqreeban pH 8.2 se 10) aur methyl red (taqreeban pH 4.4 se 6.2), flasks ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3: Strong acid-strong base titration curve (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shuru mein pH taqreeban 1 hai kyunke sirf strong acid hai. 40 mL par sara acid neutralize ho jata hai aur pH 4 se 10 tak achanak uchhalta hai; equivalence point par pH 7.00. Phenolphthalein (8.2 se 10) aur methyl red (4.4 se 6.2) dono ki range isi seedhe hisse mein hai, is liye dono kaam kar sakte hain.

Aabi NH₃ ki HCl se titration lein. Shuru mein solution mein sirf weak base hai jo thora dissociate hota hai, is liye OH⁻ strong base se kam hota hai. Shuru ka pH 7 se zyada magar strong base ke pH se kam hota hai. HCl dalne se OH⁻ kam hota jata hai aur pH girta hai.

Equivalence point se pehle solution buffer jaise hisse (buffer region) mein hota hai jahan pH aahista badalta hai. Weak base aur us ka conjugate acid (bane hue salt se) mil kar buffer ka kaam karte hain, aur acid dalne par pH ki tabdeeli ko narm (moderate) karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai “as the base is added”; is titration mein HCl (acid) dala ja raha hai, is liye sahi “as the acid is added” hai.

blocks.alt: Titration curve: pH (0 se 14) ke muqable shamil kiye gaye HCl(aq) ka hajm (0 se 80 mL). pH taqreeban 11 se shuru ho kar 'buffer region' mein aahista girta hai (curve ke saath gulabi patti, jo phenolphthalein ki range bhi hai), 40 mL par tezi se girta hai aur 1.5 ke qareeb thehar jata hai. Dashed lakeerein taqreeban pH 9.2 aur 'pH = 5.27 at equivalence point' par. Methyl red ki patti tez girawat ko kaat-ti hai, flask ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4: Strong acid-weak base titration curve (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shuru mein pH taqreeban 11 hai (weak base). Buffer region mein pH aahista girta hai, is liye phenolphthalein ki range (gulabi patti) yahan dheere dheere guzar jati hai aur munasib nahi. Equivalence point par pH 5.27 hai (NH₄⁺ halka acidic), aur methyl red ki patti tez girawat wale hisse par hai, is liye yahan woh behtar hai.
Equivalence point par pH 7 se kam (pH = 5.27) hota hai, kyunke conjugate acid NH₄⁺ thora dissociate ho kar H⁺ chhorta hai aur solution acidic ho jata hai (NH₄⁺ → NH₃ + H⁺).

Equivalence point ke baad pH tezi se girta hai, kyunke ab zyada dala gaya strong acid poora dissociate ho kar bohat H⁺ deta hai. Methyl orange isi range mein rang badalta hai, is liye strong acid-weak base titration ke liye munasib indicator hai.

blocks.prompt: a) End point aur equivalence point mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Equivalence point woh hai jahan titrant ne analyte ko bilkul poora neutralize kar diya (hisab ki baat). End point woh hai jahan indicator rang badalta hai (aankh se dekhi baat). Indicator aisa chunte hain ke end point equivalence point ke jitna ho sake qareeb ho.

blocks.prompt: b) Indicator acidic aur basic solution mein rang kaise badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Indicator weak acid HIn hai: HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻, aur HIn aur In⁻ ke rang alag hain. Acid mein H⁺ zyada hai, equilibrium baen taraf chalta hai aur HIn ka rang dikhta hai. Base mein OH⁻ H⁺ ko pani bana kar hata deta hai, HIn aur ionize hota hai, In⁻ zyada ho jata hai aur base wala rang dikhta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Weak acid aur strong base ki titration ke liye munasib indicator batayein.
blocks.explanation: Equivalence point par salt ka anion hydrolyse ho kar OH⁻ deta hai, is liye pH 7 se zyada (basic) hota hai. Is liye phenolphthalein (8.2 se 10.0) munasib hai (Table 9.7).

blocks.prompt: d) Weak acid aur weak base ki titration ke liye munasib indicator batayein.
blocks.explanation: Is titration mein equivalence point ke aas paas pH aahista badalta hai, tez uchhal nahi hota, is liye koi aam indicator tez rang ki tabdeeli nahi deta. Aisi titrations aam taur par indicator ke saath nahi ki jatin.

items: Titration curve: titrant ke hajm ke muqable pH. Equivalence point = bilkul neutralization; end point = indicator ka rang badalna, jo equivalence point ke qareeb chuna jata hai.
HCl–NaOH: kam pH se shuru, pH 7 par equivalence, 4 se 10 tak tez uchhal; phenolphthalein.
NH₃–HCl: 7 se oopar shuru, buffer region, pH 5.27 par equivalence (NH₄⁺ acidic); methyl orange.
